title: Two-finger scrolling
drDigitalIntro:
Scrolling lets you see more of a long page.
• On a trackpad: place two fingers side by side and slide them up or down.
• On a mouse: roll the scroll wheel with your index finger.
• Scroll down slowly to reveal more content at the bottom.
• Scroll back up to go back to the top.

playgroundTask.instructions: Scroll down using two fingers to find the code, then scroll back up and type it into the box.

drDigitalSuccess: You found it and scrolled right back! Two-finger scrolling is officially yours.
drDigitalHint: Two fingers on the trackpad — slide them down to scroll. On a mouse, roll the wheel down. Keep scrolling until the secret code appears.
